acceptance.purpose: Retain curator-reviewed operating procedures and concrete exercises for later research; do not discard them merely because an archive trial is null, harmful or underpowered.
acceptance.source_skill: Separately established correctness of declared source-informed operation; these notes do not issue that acceptance.
acceptance.agent_skill: Separate original agent-owned contextual use and mature outcomes; these curator cases are not agent experience.

shared_execution_convention.clock: Rows carry original UTC bar-open time. An observation is consumable only at or after row.time + configured bar_duration_seconds; illustrative M5 clocks below use 300 seconds.
shared_execution_convention.exercise_scope: Synthetic, conditional arithmetic cases. Stated mature EMA, band, ATR and pivot snapshots are premises to inspect, not claimed market observations or a replacement for the original OHLC feature owner.
shared_execution_convention.action: All fourteen primary methods target confirmation. True can only let an already existing same-direction candidate continue through its other guards. False or unavailable means WAIT/veto for this additional gate; neither result creates an entry, risk change, fill, PnL or reward.
shared_execution_convention.normalization: Unless stated otherwise, ATR in these primary methods means the local arithmetic mean of fourteen gap-aware true ranges, in price units; ratios are dimensionless. This differs from Wilder ATR smoothing in the reviewed Fidelity reference.
shared_execution_convention.scope: The exact method context remains authoritative. A use described as an alternative is not an installed method or expanded context. Runtime booleans are computed by the owner, never injected from a source page or user-supplied method column.

source_reviews.reviewed_scope: Manual pages 1-3 explain BandWidth, a 125-period low and adjustable squeeze buffer/lookback. Public Band Rules supplied related context. The lab does not claim to reproduce the proprietary programme, the complete book, videos or publisher outcomes.

supplemental_profiles.calculation_convention: Use each completed twenty-close SMA and population standard deviation to calculate upper/lower bands at two deviations. BandWidth=(upper-lower)/positive middle. A squeeze is a BandWidth at its trailing125 mature-width minimum, including ties with zero buffer. One squeeze must occur in the previous five completed observations. The previous close must be inside its own lower and upper bands, including equality at either boundary. BUY now closes strictly above the current upper band and previous close; SELL mirrors below the lower band. The last six M5 bars must be contiguous. First possible current availability is index144 because the rolling minimum needs125 mature widths, not125 raw bars.
supplemental_profiles.source_vs_lab: The manual supports normalized BandWidth and a historical squeeze lookback. Population deviation, a zero buffer including ties, previous-five observation timing, fresh strict cross with directional price movement, six contiguous M5 bars and trend_up/London/normal are explicit lab hypotheses. The source's default three-percent buffer and proprietary implementation are not reproduced. The old disjoint5/20 true-range proxy remains its own primary method and evidence; a narrow true-range ratio is not a Bollinger BandWidth squeeze.
operating_steps: Reopen the exact source, method and recipe revision and preserve its declared context. Start with an existing BUY or SELL proposal; this operator supplies no direction.

Read only original completed OHLC through the closed feature owner. Require twenty-close band maturity,125 mature BandWidths and six contiguous tail bars; CSV-provided method flags cannot fill missing history.
Locate a zero-buffer historical minimum in the previous five closed observations. Treat the squeeze as compression knowledge, not as an immediate direction or a trade.
Require the current strict fresh same-direction outside close from a previous inside-or-equal close. A tag, continued outside close, absent directional move or opposite candidate does not confirm.

Record target reach, availability, actual confirmation/veto, changed decisions and matched cost-inclusive ledger outcomes separately. Preserve original risk, stops, sizing, costs, admission and exit ownership.
wait_when: BandWidth history is immature, middle is nonpositive/nonfinite, or the last six M5 bars are not contiguous.
No squeeze exists in the previous five completed observations, or the current bar only touches its band.
The previous close was already outside the same directional band, the current price does not move in the candidate direction, or a complete breakout is absent.
Original context, data, risk, cost or admission guards refuse; unavailable observations never become invented passes.
alternatives: Keep the old5/20 true-range ratio as a separately named compression proxy with its own exact rule and controls; do not pool its outcomes with normalized BandWidth.
A positive manual buffer, another lookback or an alternative breakout confirmation requires a separately declared prospective revision before new outcomes.
Use BASELINE or WAIT when the hypothesis has no matching valid opportunity; low sample size and failed availability remain research gaps.

source_reviews.reviewed_scope: Direction, dip/rally location and calculation reviewed; the exact two-bar condition below comes from the installed local owner.

operating_steps: At the closed decision clock, verify the existing direction and exact London/trend_up/normal context; obtain original mature EMA20/50 from the owner.
For BUY inspect t-1: low<=EMA20, EMA50<close<=EMA20 and EMA20>EMA50. Then require t close>its EMA20 and previous close, with fast still above slow. Mirror every comparison for SELL.
Require both adjacent EMA observations mature and exactly one configured bar apart; evaluate available AND bounce. A setup without the completed reclaim waits.
Record whether the candidate reached, had usable inputs, passed or was vetoed. Follow the original risk/execution guards after a pass; no entry is produced by this gate.

source_reviews.reviewed_scope: Read prior-period channel construction and close-based break discussion; frozen level and next-three-bar retest are local state choices.

operating_steps: Build high/low extrema from twenty closed bars preceding the breakout bar. Verify the previous close lies on or inside the relevant boundary before the current strict crossing.
On BUY crossing previous_close<=prior_high<close, freeze that high and breakout index. Do not confirm on this same bar; SELL mirrors the low.
During only the next one to three contiguous bars, BUY requires low<=frozen_level and close>frozen_level; SELL mirrors it. Consume the event once.
Opposing close, gap or expiry clears the pending setup. Require method_retest_available AND same-direction method_retest_confirmed before the existing proposal can continue.

runtime_conditions.units: frozen level and OHLC in price units
runtime_conditions.timing: breakout cannot retest itself; next1..3 configured contiguous bars only; a consumed confirmation cannot rearm itself

wait_when: No mature prior20 channel or adjacent previous bar.
Only a breakout has occurred, or a later candle has not touched and reclaimed the frozen level.
A close equals the boundary, the third-bar window expires or direction differs.
invalidation: BUY close below the frozen level cancels; SELL close above cancels.
A source time gap or a fourth following bar cancels the pending breakout.
alternatives: A close-only channel breakout can be studied without a retest, as a different declared treatment.
internet_closed_breakout_retest_v1@1 is a construction adapter with moving-boundary behavior; its native one-bar retest and continuation branches are not this frozen event.
profiles.source_vs_lab: The product reference defines a preceding-period channel; CME discusses broken-level role change. Period20, frozen-level storage, three-bar expiry, strict close and single consumption are local choices, with no asserted successful transfer.

Counting the breakout wick as its own retest
Reusing a consumed signal on several candidate bars
agent_practice: Keep separate logs for arm, pending WAIT, retest, cancellation and actual reached candidate use.
implementation_gaps: A longer retest window, ATR buffer or repeated retests require a separately declared state machine rather than changing this method's interpretation.

source_reviews.reviewed_scope: Read true-range calculation and nondirectional volatility interpretation.
Read PDF pages1-3, band/width formulas and squeeze-break alert. This primary TR method does not implement that band algorithm.

operating_steps: Compute each completed true range as max(high-low, abs(high-prior_close), abs(low-prior_close)); first row uses high-low.
At t compare meanTR[t-5..t-1] with the disjoint meanTR[t-25..t-6]. The current expansion bar belongs to neither baseline.
Require prior5<0.7*preceding20 and currentTR>1.5*prior5, plus positive mature local ATR14 history. Both comparisons are strict.
Pass only the existing directional candidate's confirmation. A large range does not itself assign BUY/SELL, and a small ATR is not a completed expansion event.

runtime_conditions.units: TR means in price units;0.7 and1.5 dimensionless
runtime_conditions.timing: twenty-five prior observations plus the current completed bar; baseline is not necessarily gap-free elapsed time

wait_when: The disjoint25-bar history is immature or ATR14 is nonpositive.
The contraction or expansion condition is false or exactly equal.
Only an intrabar range expansion exists; the current bar has not closed.
invalidation: This is a one-bar event gate with no persistent arming state; recompute at the next completed bar.
A past narrow period cannot be carried indefinitely as permission for a later unrelated expansion.
alternatives: A genuine BandWidth setup first computes SMA20+/-2 standard deviations and BW=(upper-lower)/middle, then compares BW with its own historical low before a band break. The separately declared internet_closed_bandwidth_squeeze_breakout_v1@1 uses the lab's population deviation,125-bar low, prior-five squeeze search, zero buffer and strict directional outside close; it is not the manual's complete Method I or default3-percent buffer.
A pure ATR contraction threshold and a Donchian-channel break are separate hypotheses; neither may be renamed a Bollinger Squeeze.
profiles.source_vs_lab: True-range volatility and normalized band dispersion are distinct measurements. The local5/20 TR proxy,0.7/1.5 thresholds and context are laboratory choices; the creator manual's buffer details do not specify this proxy. Both approaches need actual usage evidence separately.
common_mistakes: Putting currentTR into the compression baseline
Treating a quiet market as a directional trigger
Calling TR contraction a complete Method I implementation
agent_practice: Calculate both disjoint means by hand, then explain which measurement a selected recipe really consumes.
implementation_gaps: The old method has no Bollinger BandWidth feature; a genuine normalized-width method requires its own implementation and identity, supplied separately rather than relabelling this proxy.
The reviewed manual mentions a default3-percent adjustable buffer; exact proprietary semantics were not verified and must not be invented.

source_reviews.reviewed_scope: Read interval/day, timezone and bar-membership sections; the local20-bar growing-prefix break is independently specified in code.

operating_steps: Resolve the canonical selection calendar and explicit session instance before collecting extrema. Preserve an explicitly unknown identity as unavailable.
Save current-group high/low before inserting t, then update extrema and same-group observed-bar count using the completed t candle.
Once count>=20 and ATR14>0, BUY distance=(close-prior_prefix_high)/ATR; SELL distance=(prior_prefix_low-close)/ATR. Current prefix width=(high-low)/ATR.
Require session availability, distance>0 and0.25<width<4. A pass only confirms the existing direction. Reset on a new session instance.

runtime_conditions.rule: available AND distance>0 AND width>0.25 AND width<4
runtime_conditions.units: distance and width in current ATR multiples
runtime_conditions.timing: twenty observed group bars, not a frozen opening interval; current width includes t, crossed extreme excludes t

wait_when: Fewer than20 actual group observations, unknown identity or nonpositive ATR.
Close is at/inside the prior extreme, or width is at/outside either strict boundary.
The source candle is not closed or the requested context differs.
invalidation: New instance/date-session grouping discards prior prefix state.
A future session extreme cannot revise the earlier decision.
alternatives: Freeze an opening interval only after its declared final candle closes, then test later crossings under a separately declared opening-range method.
A prior completed-session high/low or a rolling20-bar channel uses another level owner and must keep that identity.
profiles.source_vs_lab: The platform documentation supplies session-time handling concerns; twenty observations, UTC grouping and0.25/4 ATR boundaries are local. Fixed UTC London labels are not certified exchange or broker daylight-saving sessions.

Comparing a close with an extreme that already includes that close's bar
Calling20 observations a complete100-minute interval when there are missing bars

implementation_gaps: Frozen opening-range and previous-completed-session state are not implemented by this growing-prefix method.
A completeness requirement across session gaps would need its own declared guard; existing count is observation-based.

source_reviews.reviewed_scope: Read rules6-14 on touches, trends, outside closes and calculation choices; the two-bar inward reentry is a bounded local interpretation.

operating_steps: For t-1 and t separately compute SMA20 and2*population standard deviation from each bar's own twenty completed closes; require both positive-width windows.
BUY needs t-1 close below its own lower band, t close strictly inside its own bands and t close>t-1 close. SELL mirrors the upper-band excursion and downward inward move.
At t close evaluate method_band_available AND same-direction method_band_reentry for the existing range/London/normal candidate.
If it fails, wait for a new complete qualifying pair. Do not impose a midpoint target or assume a touched band mandates reversal.

runtime_conditions.rule: available AND directional strict outside-to-inside movement
runtime_conditions.units: bands in price units;SD multiplier2 dimensionless
runtime_conditions.timing: both windows include their own completed endpoint; unlike EMA/retest this feature has no explicit adjacency-gap check

wait_when: Either twenty-close band is immature or has zero width.
Prior close only touches the band, current close remains outside/equal, or price has not moved inward.
A matching strategy proposal and exact range context are absent.
invalidation: Continuing outside closes do not complete a reentry.
Changing band width around a stationary close cannot satisfy the price-movement comparison.
alternatives: A momentum-confirmed band continuation and a multi-swing W-bottom/M-top pattern require separate conditions and state.

common_mistakes: Fading a persistent trend merely because it tags a band
Using today's bands to judge yesterday's close
Treating band widening as inward price movement
agent_practice: Draw both historical envelopes and annotate actual close movement separately before classifying a case.
implementation_gaps: A gap-free consecutive-bar variant would need an explicit new availability guard; the current band pair uses consecutive observations.
Multi-swing W/M pattern state is absent from this two-bar method.

source_reviews.reviewed_scope: Read potential-level and break/role-reversal use; the finite OR topology is a local composition, not a published optimization system.

operating_steps: Verify positive closed history and the exact proposal context before checking either route.
Route A is a new directional crossing of a previously known pivot level; route B is directional excursion-and-close reclaim of the owner's selected level.
Compute history_available AND (method_bos OR method_sweep_reclaim). One qualifying route is sufficient; zero routes waits.
Record which route was present and whether it changed actual candidate behavior. Let a later own policy learn route preference from its own evidence.

runtime_conditions.units: boolean routes; price-level details remain with their feature owners
runtime_conditions.timing: completed events available at the decision clock; no continuously learned weights

wait_when: History is unavailable, even if route flags are supplied.
Neither direction-aligned route is true.
An attractive route belongs to another direction or context.
invalidation: Do not retain a previous one-bar BOS/reclaim as a current event unless another declared owner stores that state.
alternatives: Requiring both routes is an AND intervention with different coverage, not an interpretation of the installed OR.
A native specialist consensus/router uses separate voters and state. Correlated price-derived routes are not independent evidence just because there are two labels.
profiles.source_vs_lab: Source material informs level analysis and cautions about redundant indicators; the Boolean union, exact events and context are local. The method adapts allowed route topology only, without estimating an optimal selector.
common_mistakes: Requiring both OR branches
Counting correlated routes as independent confirmations
Giving the OR method authority to invent direction
agent_practice: Tabulate break-only, reclaim-only, neither and unavailable-history cases, then keep route coverage separate from economic usefulness.
implementation_gaps: A learned route-weight policy requires a separate trained or agent-owned artifact; no such optimizer exists in this AST.

source_reviews.reviewed_scope: Read PDF pages15-17 on peak/trough anchors, optional retracement levels and potential-area cautions; no recorded video or historical chart outcome was consumed.

operating_steps: At the actual decision clock retrieve latest known unique2-left/2-right high and low. Require both, high>low and positive current ATR; confirmation arrives two observations after the pivot.
Compute BUY fraction=(high-close)/(high-low), SELL fraction=(close-low)/(high-low). Use the already existing proposal's direction.
Require swing_available AND0.382<fraction<0.618. The fraction is location context, with no automatic reversal trigger or price target.
Record the two anchor prices and confirmation clocks. If the owner replaces an anchor, recompute prospectively without rewriting the old decision.

runtime_conditions.units: fraction of positive high-low width, not percent-number38.2
runtime_conditions.timing: latest confirmed high/low, not necessarily a strictly alternating impulse pair

wait_when: One anchor is unknown, high<=low, ATR is unavailable or the decision precedes confirmation.
Fraction equals either boundary, lies outside the zone or is supplied in percentage-number units.
invalidation: An anchor replacement changes the current zone; earlier signals remain bound to their original anchors.
A broken high/low can put fraction outside0..1; do not clip it to manufacture zone membership.
alternatives: The transcript discusses23.6 and78.6-percent locations as alternatives; each requires separate declared bounds if made executable.
A chronological alternating low-to-high impulse selector could track one completed swing leg; that is a new anchor algorithm, absent from this primary owner.
profiles.source_vs_lab: References explain two-extreme retracement areas. Unique2+2 pivots, latest-high/latest-low storage and the strict0.382..0.618 gate are local. The code does not enforce strict pivot alternation despite shorthand catalog wording about an opposite pair.
common_mistakes: Using the eventual peak before it was known
Entering solely because a retracement fraction is near a familiar number
Claiming latest independent extrema are necessarily one chronological impulse
agent_practice: Show anchor availability on a timeline, calculate BUY/SELL fractions and explain why location still needs an actual proposal and trigger.
implementation_gaps: Strictly alternating chronological impulse anchors would need a separate state machine and tests; the present owner retains independent latest extrema.

operating_steps: Test candidate index p only at p+2 using two closed highs/lows on each side; the candidate must be the unique maximum/minimum of that five-observation window.
Store the pivot price with confirmation index p+2. Retain latest known high and low and require positive width and current local ATR14.
